title: La última luciérnaga
originalBrief: Quiero una pequeña aventura 3D isométrica jugable con personaje, entorno con profundidad, NPC, objeto coleccionable, diálogo/decisión y un objetivo final.
preventiveDecisions: Compared genuine external rigged GLB route vs original illustrated 2.5D characters in real 3D world; selected original editorial illustrations for controlled appearance, rights, memory and consistent mobile load.
No primitive-built humanoids; animal character silhouettes drawn on CanvasTexture with detailed cloak, face, expressive eyes and accessories.
Low-poly physical scene with island cliff, trees, paths, pond, lighthouse, light and shadows, fixed isometric camera.
Single pinned Three.js ES module version; original assets generated locally in canvas to avoid broken third-party textures.
Touch and mouse click-to-walk plus keyboard and accessible on-screen joystick; dialogue buttons >= 51 CSS px.
One brief per branch and unique public path; avoid shared flow and manifest edits.
stageTrace: scope
Pinned literal vertical-slice brief with player, depth, NPC, collectible, dialogue/choice and goal.
recovery
Read launcher 7, W4 manifest and universal 2.3.0 method, stages, contract and concurrency rules.
planning
Designed complete two-branch loop: explore, collect, consult, decide, activate, success/failure, restart.
acquisition
Selected self-authored Canvas textures and procedural 3D geometry; Three.js pinned as only external library.
classification
Character illustrated sprites, environment physical meshes, shrine collectible, quest/state UI.
humanoid
No human cast. Fox and owl drawn as bespoke 2D illustrations on camera-facing 3D planes.
props
Original collectable crystal shrine, stones, benches/sign, lanterns, architectural lighthouse.
environment
Elevated island with depth, pond, trees, flowers, path and water, actual 3D parallax.
fx
Warm directional shadow lighting, atmospheric fog, luminous crystals, fireflies and ending changes.
assembly
Playable keyboard, touch joystick, click-to-walk, action, dialogue, clock and end-state code.
orientation
Billboards face isometric camera; keyboard directions mapped to projected screen axes.
acting
Player walks/bobs, owl idles, crystal floats, scene reacts to choices.
cinema
Orthographic 3/4 camera softly tracks player and preserves world-space placement.
qa
Preventive art/method decision before production; actual browser and Android visual review NOT_RUN.
repair
No postproduction aesthetic repair loop or shared-flow mutation; human feedback pending.
persistence
Source code saved in private candidate branch and public isolated path, pinned brief and flow.
publish
Public candidate intended for GH Pages; no claim of human visual approval.
